site.name: USA Election Tracker
site.tagline: Candidates, campaign finance, district maps, and past results for the November 3, 2026 U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and governor elections. Every figure links to its source.
nav.label: Main
footer.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with any government agency, political party, or campaign. No endorsements.
footer.verify: Data is compiled from public sources and may contain errors or delays. Official results come only from state and local election officials. Always verify with them.
footer.unofficial: Any election night figures shown here are unofficial and lag the official source.
footer.privacy: Privacy: page views are counted with GoatCounter, which sets no cookies. Addresses and locations you use on this site never leave your browser.
race.heading: {office}: {title}
race.candidates.official: Candidates as listed by state election officials.
race.candidates.fecFallback: This list shows candidates registered with the Federal Election Commission for this race. It is not the official ballot and may include people who will not appear on it. Check the official candidate list from your state.
race.candidates.unavailable: We have not yet compiled an official candidate list for this race. See your state election office for the official list.
race.candidates.none: No candidates are listed for this race in the official source.
race.order.ballot: Listed in ballot order as shown by the official source.
race.order.alphabetical: Listed alphabetically by last name. The official source does not give a ballot order.
race.col.name: Candidate
race.partyNote: Party labels appear exactly as the source lists them.
race.openPrimary: On {date}, this contest is an open primary: all candidates appear on one ballot regardless of party. If no candidate meets the threshold set by state law, a runoff is scheduled for {runoff}.
finance.heading: Campaign finance
finance.intro: Totals reported to the Federal Election Commission by each candidate's authorized committees for the 2025 to 2026 cycle, through the coverage end date shown.
finance.chartAlphabetical: Total receipts, alphabetical by last name
finance.notApplicable: Candidates for governor do not file with the FEC. State campaign finance reports are available from each state.
finance.noMatchNote: "No FEC filing matched" means we could not confidently link this candidate to an FEC record. Some candidates are not required to file. We do not guess.
map.heading: District map
map.caption: {title} under the boundaries in effect for the 2026 election.
map.unavailable: A map of this district is not available yet.
map.altTable: The district outline is described by its boundary file, which you can download from the Data page.
history.heading: Past results for this seat
history.houseNote: Results for district {district} under the boundaries in effect at the time of each election. District lines change after redistricting, so these may describe different areas than the 2026 district.
history.none: No historical results are available for this seat in our sources.
history.order: Ordered by votes received, as reported in the certified results.
history.partyCodes: Party labels are shown as coded in the source dataset (for example D, R, Lbt).
demo.heading: District demographics
demo.vintage: Census American Community Survey 5-year estimates, 2020 to 2024. Margins of error are at the 90 percent confidence level.
demo.notAvailableChanged: Not available for this district's 2026 boundaries. The Census Bureau publishes these estimates for the district lines used in 2024. {state} adopted new lines for 2026, so those estimates describe a different area. We do not approximate.
demo.notice: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

results.official: Official results for this race will be posted by {office}.

map.locator: Where {state} sits on the national map.
state.listStatus.fec_registrants: FEC registrants, not the official ballot
state.noSenate: No U.S. Senate election in {state} in 2026.
state.raceList: Each link opens the race page.
states.title: States
states.intro: Choose a state to see every 2026 U.S. House, U.S. Senate, and governor race on its ballot, with links to its official election office.
home.lookupHeading: Find the races on your ballot
home.lookupBody: Use your location to find your congressional district. Your location stays in your browser.
home.houseCount: {count} U.S. House seats, including the District of Columbia delegate
home.p1: Every figure links to the source it came from.
home.p2: Candidates are listed in ballot order when the official source gives one, otherwise alphabetically by last name.
home.p3: Party names appear exactly as the official source lists them.
home.p4: We do not forecast, rate races, or call winners.
updated.heading: Data last updated
updated.stale: Out of date: the last update attempt for this source failed. Showing the last good data, retrieved {date}.
lookup.title: Find your ballot
lookup.intro: Find your congressional district and the races on your ballot on November 3, 2026.
lookup.privacy: Your location is used only inside your browser to match it against district boundaries. It is never sent to us or stored.
lookup.locationDenied: We could not get your location. You can choose your state and select your district on the map instead.
lookup.noGeolocation: Your browser does not support location lookup. Choose your state and select your district on the map instead.
lookup.outside: That location is not inside a U.S. state or the District of Columbia in our boundary files.
lookup.nearBoundary: This location is close to a district boundary. Please confirm your district with the official lookup from your state.
lookup.mapHelp: Select the district where you live on the map, or choose it from the list. The map shows district boundaries only.
lookup.mapStates: Select your state on the map to see its districts.
lookup.noJs: The lookup needs JavaScript. You can browse your state's races from the States page instead.
lookup.accuracy: District boundaries are simplified for speed. Results near a boundary may be wrong. Your state's official lookup is the authority.
lookup.loadError: Boundary data could not be loaded. Please try again later or use the States page.
howToVote.title: How to vote
howToVote.intro: Rules for registering and voting differ by state and can change. We do not restate them here, because errors cause real harm. Use the official links below.
howToVote.voteGov: Vote.gov, the federal government's registration site, run by the U.S. Election Assistance Commission
night.title: Election night
night.intro: Official results come from state and local election officials. Use the links below for each state's official results site.
night.noCalls: This site does not project or call races, and does not show winners.
night.liveDisabled: Live results on this site are turned off. Use the official links above.
night.liveLag: Updates on this site lag the official source by several minutes or more, because they run on a schedule and pages are cached. The official source is always more current.
downloads.title: Data downloads
downloads.intro: Every dataset this site uses, in CSV and JSON. Our compilation is licensed CC BY 4.0. Underlying sources keep their own licenses, listed on the Sources page.
sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Every source cited on this site. Citation markers next to figures link here.
corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.intro: A public, dated log of errors we have corrected. To report an error, open an issue.
corrections.none: No corrections have been logged yet.
